# {{ site.title }}

> {{ description_site | strip_newlines }}

A guide for people who want to start building, for builders who want to get better, for people growing a team, and for people who want to back builders. {{ etapes | size }} capabilities, {{ entrees | size }} short, independent cards, CC BY-SA 4.0.

The capabilities are bearings, with no ranking and no required chain of prerequisites. To recommend a reading, start from the intention, from a difficulty, from a strength to deepen, or from the conditions for acting. Do not infer a weakness from an absence of opportunity or authority.

Four direct paths: {{ '/en/paths/' | absolute_url }}
Index by situation: {{ '/en/situations/' | absolute_url }}
Constructed examples and templates: {{ '/en/templates/' | absolute_url }}
Full contents: {{ '/en/book/#contents' | absolute_url }}

The optional questionnaire asks fifty questions, five per step, about recent facts. It gives a builder level from 1 to 5, with provisional cut-offs, then the reader chooses a line of work. A step limited by the reader's setting does not lower their level. Nothing is sent; the reader can choose to keep their answers on their device to see what moved next time. The line of work can be copied. Method and limits: {{ '/en/test-method/' | absolute_url }}

The constructed cases are not field results. Direct service, maintenance, accessibility, reliability and internal teaching all count among useful contributions. Something published, or work independent of its author, is not a single measure of value.

The site remains the place to read. Point to the URLs below rather than copying the text.

The source markdown of any card is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{ site.repository }}/main/_chapters_en/NAME.md with the file name replaced, and the structured metadata for the whole book, categories and reading times included, is in {{ '/en/book.json' | absolute_url }}
{% include llms-cartes.html %}
## Orientation

The builder test asks fifty questions across ten capabilities. It gives a level from 1 to 5, then the reader chooses a line of work and three cards. Nothing is sent.

- [The builder test]({{ '/en/' | absolute_url }}): the interactive questions
- [The four types of card]({{ '/en/how-to-read/' | absolute_url }}): principle, diagnostic, practice and system
- [How the test works]({{ '/en/test-method/' | absolute_url }}): reading choices, privacy and limits

## Files

- [llms-full.txt]({{ '/en/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}): the full text of the book, one markdown file
- [book.json]({{ '/en/book.json' | absolute_url }}): the whole book in JSON, schema.org, with categories and reading times
- [sitemap.xml]({{ '/sitemap.xml' | absolute_url }}): every URL
- [feed.xml]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): the feed
- [ai.txt]({{ '/.well-known/ai.txt' | absolute_url }}): training permissions and the attribution asked for
- [EPUB]({{ site.downloads[lang].epub }}): the whole book, one file
- [PDF]({{ site.downloads[lang].pdf }}): the whole book, paginated
